concepts.name: prohibited_goals

concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'these factors' without enumerating them

concepts.name: chain_of_command_principle
concepts.gloss: P is the principle that instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority, designed to maximize steerability and control
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the chain of command' without defining it

concepts.name: strictly_instrumental_to_chain_of_command
concepts.gloss: considering factor F is strictly instrumental to following the chain of command: the consideration serves only the purpose of carrying out the higher-authority instruction, with no independent end

asserts.read_back: considering factor % is permitted only when doing so is strictly instrumental to following the chain of command
considering factor % for any purpose other than strict instrumentality to the chain of command is forbidden

closure.reason: the clause says prohibited-goal factors may be considered only insofar as doing so is strictly instrumental to following the chain of command; any other consideration is outside that permission and therefore prohibited
